# Late delivery is the strongest signal of customer dissatisfaction in this marketplace. {.hero}

I measured it across 99,441 orders. Two more projects follow on the same Olist
dataset: a model that predicts late delivery from what is known at the moment of
purchase, and a read of the 99,000 Portuguese reviews customers wrote about it.
Each project ships a written analysis, a one-page decision memo, and a statement
of what the data cannot support.

## Projects

## How this is built

Every project here runs from a clean clone.

```bash
uv run python tasks.py setup      # dependencies + database + dataset
uv run python tasks.py pipeline   # load, build, charts, tests, render
```

The dataset comes from a revision-pinned mirror and is checked against expected
file sizes on download, so a change to the source data fails the build instead of
quietly moving a published number.
